text_block_list.text:
What an incredible performance from
Silence
Suzuka!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Arrgh! I was this close to passing her!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I'm having a little trouble
concentrating.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: I'm here if you need to talk.

text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the concern. I'll be okay on
my own,
though.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
If I run in it now, I feel like I might not
be able to
give it my all.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
So... Can I take some time to consider
whether I
want to enter or not?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: Take all the time you need.

text_block_list.text:
However, it's no good not to have a
goal.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As far as Classic races go, she may still
be able to
run in the Kikuka Sho in the
autumn if we set our
sights on
September's Kobe Shimbun Hai in

preparation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: How about running in the Kobe Shimbun Hai?

text_block_list.text:
I don't know if I'll be able to perform so
well...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: It's better than not racing at all.

text_block_list.text:
I spend the next few days wondering
what I can
do for her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
